method: Current Corven source panels were selected by exact mesh name, baked into independent in-memory glTF nodes, passed through the production attachItemSkin analytic adapter without rigid hints, parsed by GLTFLoader, and CPU-skinned with SkinnedMesh.applyBoneTransform. These are the actual prior diagnostic command outputs, recorded after the run. No source hashes were captured then.
edgeSelection: All triangle edges with bind length greater than 0.006 meters; duplicate triangle edges retained
conclusion: Spatial analytic weights vary within rigid panels and deform their edge lengths. The outer pauldron already weighted entirely to upperarm_l preserves edge lengths. Rigid per-panel bone hints are appropriate for plates, with soft weighting reserved for flexible linings.
limitation: These measurements diagnose the former analytic weighting path and are not acceptance evidence for later hinted exports or worn screenshots.
